† शुण्ठ् शुण्ठ्, i. 1, Par. To be lame.
 --i. 1. and 10, Par. To be dried or desiccated.
शुण्ठि, ठी शुण्ठी̆, f., and शुण्ठ्य शुण्ठ्य, n. Dry ginger, Pañc. 262, 13 (य).

. To break.
 2. To vex, to torment.

शुण्ड,
 I. m. The exudation from an elephant's temples.
 II. f. डा.
 1. Spirituous liquor.
 2. A tavern.
 3. An elephant's trunk, Pañc. 165, 1.
 4. The stalk of the lotus.
 5. A whore.
शुण्डक (cf. the last), m. A distiller.

शुण्डार (cf. शुण्ड), m.
 1. A distiller.
 2. An elephant's trunk,
शुण्डी in कण्ठ्-, f. Swelling of the kernels of the throat,
